name: cut_trees_for_wood
description: Mine 30 trees to obtain at least 30 Wood.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: obtain_workbench
description: Cut trees for wood and craft one WorkBench into inventory.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: get_wooden_hammer
description: Obtain a WoodenHammer by cutting trees, crafting a WorkBench, then crafting the hammer.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: mine_stone_blocks
description: Mine 30 StoneBlock using the existing CopperPickaxe

name: make_wooden_chair_and_table
description: Craft a wooden chair and table using the workbench helper.
task: Hold a wooden chair and a wooden table (any wood variant counts).

name: get_wooden_door
description: Obtain a wooden door by cutting trees, crafting a workbench, then crafting the door.
task: Hold a wooden door (any wood variant counts).

name: hold_furnace_corrected
description: Gather missing stone, create a workbench, and craft a Furnace.

description: Cut trees, craft a WorkBench, then craft a WoodenHammer.
